description: NaCoBO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.70 Å. Co is bonded to six O atoms to form face-sharing CoO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.19 Å. B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All B-O bond lengths are 1.39 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Co, and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, two equivalent Co, and one B atom.
